data.description:
## Incident Overview
t_pr_poll_succeeds_on_merged_state_exit_zero fails in CI with: ERROR: PR reported merged but merge commit SHA not found on origin/main.
The git fetch origin main via git shim's exec delegation does not appear to populate refs/remotes/origin/main in the CI environment, even though a pre-fetch was added to the fixture setup.
Test passes locally (macOS/bash) but fails on every CI run (Ubuntu/bash).
data.title: [test-merge-to-main-pr]: git log origin/main in CI -> merge commit SHA not found
